priorityList: Summon your pet before combat begins.
Use Power Infusion and combat potions while Bestial Wrath is active.
Use racial abilities (Berserking, Blood Fury, Ancestral Call, or Fireblood) during Bestial Wrath.
Use on-use trinkets like Light Company Guidon, Void Execution Mandate, or Emberwing Feather during Bestial Wrath.
For trinkets with preparation times like Algethar's Puzzle Box, use them when Bestial Wrath has less than 2 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown (less than 1.5 seconds) to ensure maximum cooldown reduction.
Prioritize Kill Command while the Sentinel-specific Nature's Ally buff is active.
Cast Kill Command if you have an Apex Predator proc available.
Cast Kill Command as long as Bestial Wrath is not immediately about to reach its full charge count.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain pet Frenzy stacks and to reduce the remaining cooldown on Bestial Wrath.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler when Kill Command and Barbed Shot are unavailable.
